Q: Is the recovery key more priority action than 2sv? Or are we making both of them fairly equal?

We think Recovery key should be more of the next step after setting up an account and sync, and we highlight why the recovery key is important. Then 2sv or other set up keys can be following.

@Jihwan Kim @Casey Tang I really liked the Adobe "Recommended" label on items that weren't set up. Not sure if you two were fans as well, but here's a quick idea: what if we had recommended labels that were clickable and able to show some guidance on why an item was recommended? (And then the modal or whatever that was displayed could take you straight into the 'set up' flow).

Just thought I'd add it as an idea to the pile – I like the idea of somehow being able to flag an item as recommended where it actually sits, and then provide an easy way for users to take action (and guide them through the action they should take).

@Tracey Vantyghem , this is where users can see what they've set up and what they are recommended to do to secure their accounts. So I thought it will be great to see some kinds of visual check marks and click through to set up right away.
@Tracey Vantyghem , something about reminder of setting up the recovery key? that can be an example to start.
